name: House Wiring
description: New and old house wiring, MCB/DB board fitting, earthing and fault finding, done safely with ISI-mark wire and fittings.

name: House Fitting
description: Fitting of switches, sockets, lights, tube lights, doorbells and inverters, plus shifting or replacing old fittings.

name: Fan Installation
description: Ceiling, wall and exhaust fan installation, regulator fitting, and fixing fan noise, wobble or slow speed.

name: Washing Machine Repair & Cleaning
description: Repair of top-load, front-load and semi-automatic machines: motor, drain, spin, timer and PCB faults, plus deep drum cleaning.

name: Geyser Repair
description: Repair of storage and instant geysers: heating element, thermostat, leakage and tripping problems.

name: Cooler Repair
description: Air cooler repair and service: motor, pump, fan, switch and wiring faults, and pad replacement.

name: Mixer Grinder Repair
description: Mixer grinder repair: motor rewinding, carbon brushes, coupler, switch and jar problems.

name: Room Heater & Electric Kettle Repair
description: Repair of room heaters, blowers and electric kettles: element, thermostat, switch and cord faults.

name: Motor Repair
description: Water pump and motor repair, rewinding, capacitor and starter replacement, and installation.
